children: A number of stocks fell in the morning session after precious metals tumbled as expectations of Federal Reserve interest rate hikes drew investors away from non-interest-bearing assets.

CNBC reported that gold fell to its lowest level in more than a year, with gold futures falling 2.34% to $3,761.84 and spot gold down 2.38% at $3,758. The report also showed that silver fell to a 52-week low, as silver futures declined 3.5% to $45.72 and spot silver shed 3.6% to $45.67.

Separately, CNBC reported that October 2026 U.S. retail sales excluding gas and autos rose 0.6%, exceeding expectations of 0.4%, while traders priced in a 95% chance of a quarter-percentage-point Federal Reserve interest rate hike, according to the CME Group’s FedWatch tool.
The stock market overreacts to news, and big price drops can present good opportunities to buy high-quality stocks.
Among others, the following stocks were impacted:
Precious metals mining company Harmony Gold Mining Company fell 7.2%.
Precious metals mining company Newmont fell 6.2%.
Precious metals mining company Pan American Silver fell 5.7%.
Precious metals mining company Aura Minerals fell 4.6%.
Precious metals mining company Hycroft Mining Holding fell 2.7%.

Every AI server needs specialized infrastructure the chip companies don’t make. High-speed cables. Power connectors. Thermal sensors. This 90-year-old company built a monopoly on it. The AI boom just started. This stock is still flying under the radar.
